Our Services

Every Detail, Perfected

From a quick refresh to a full transformation — we offer premium detailing services tailored to your vehicle and schedule.

Premium Exterior Wash

A proper hand wash that gives your car a bright, refreshed look. Wheels and inner rims cleaned, two-bucket wash, microfiber drying, tire dressing, and door jambs.

  • Two-bucket hand wash
  • Wheels & inner rims
  • Tire dressing
  • Door edges & jambs
From $80Learn more

Basic Interior Detail

A focused interior clean — deep vacuum with air blow-out, interior window cleaning, and full cleaning and protection of all leather and plastics.

  • Deep vacuum & air blow-out
  • Interior windows
  • Leather protection
  • Plastic & vinyl care
From $100Learn more

Our Process

Precision From
Start to Finish

Every Refined Auto Detailing service follows a proven, systematic process — no shortcuts, no guesswork. Just consistently exceptional results.

Our Promise

If you find anything we missed, we come back and fix it. No questions asked. That's the Refined guarantee.

01

Vehicle Inspection

15–20 minutes

We begin with a thorough inspection of your vehicle — documenting existing damage, identifying problem areas, and creating a custom plan tailored to your car's specific needs.

02

Deep Cleaning

60–90 minutes

Multi-stage wash and extraction process removes embedded dirt, grime, and contaminants from every surface — from carpet fibers to paint pores.

03

Decontamination

30–45 minutes

Chemical and physical decontamination removes iron particles, tar, and bonded contaminants that regular washing can't touch. Your paint is now truly clean.

04

Protection & Polish

45–60 minutes

Paint enhancement, dressing, and protection applied to every surface. Leather conditioned, plastics UV-protected, glass treated, and paint sealed.

05

Final Inspection

10–15 minutes

A complete walkthrough with you to ensure every detail meets our exacting standards. We don't consider the job done until you're completely satisfied.
